newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Metro up on persistent takeover rumours.
newsitem.headline: Metro up on persistent takeover rumours.

text.p: Retailer Metro Holdings rose on Tuesday morning as takeover speculation continued to surround the company, dealers said.
At 0306 GMT, Metro was up S$0.25 to S$5.60 on volume of 3.2 million shares. It touched a high of S$5.90 earlier in the morning.
Dealers said some investors continued to chase Metro shares on hopes of a takeover despite the company saying it was unaware why its share price jumped sharply last Friday.
"There could also be some accumulation because its share price is attractive compared to its estimated net asset value of S$6.80-6.90," said an institutional dealer.
